hotels.title: Fiji Coral Coast Family-Friendly Escape with Private Beach & Kids Club
hotels.description: Soak up the sun, escape the crowds and set your watch to island time on Fiji's Coral Coast at The Naviti Resort - a beachfront paradise perfect for rest and relaxation. Nestled amid tropical gardens, with a private stretch of sugar-fine sand, The Naviti Resort’s unbeatable location will instantly make you forget the outside world. Spread across 38 acres of tropical palms and just under two hours from Nadi, this is a secluded sanctuary for the entire family. Facilities include an exceptional swimming pool, swim-up bar, four distinct food and drink outlets, the indulgent Joy Spa and a stunning nine-hole golf course. Find a sun-kissed patch of sand to relax on, cool off in the azure Fijian waters or explore the pristine Coral Coast shores by boat. Venture out of the fabulous resort to discover the secrets of the nearby Biausevu Waterfall and Sigatoka Sand Dunes National Park, or take the whole family on an educational daytrip to the Kula WILD Adventure Park.

hotels.title: Fiji Coral Coast Oasis with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner, Massages & Kids Stay, Play & Eat Free
hotels.description: Surround yourself with the unspoiled beauty of Fiji’s Coral Coast, where glittering turquoise waters, towering palm trees and long stretches of golden sand provide the perfect setting for an unforgettable escape. Within moments of arrival, check into your newly-refurbished room and prepare to be met with warm Fijian hospitality as you slip into the rhythm of island time. Here, all you need to think about is which corner of the pool to laze by, where your next day trip will be, or which of the many mouthwatering restaurants you should visit tonight - will it be freshly caught seafood at Wicked Walu, Japanese fine dining at Sazanami, or international favourites at Bula Brasserie? Couples or honeymooners will love this romantic tropical haven, with days spent in the dedicated adults-only corner of the hotel or indulging in a lavish treatment at the Warwick Spa overlooking a serene lagoon. Meanwhile, families are well catered for with an array of activities for all ages, including a complimentary kids' club and pool.
